headline_pain: Stamp Duty. Body Corp. What Else?
primary_text: "What are the actual total costs? Stamp duty, council rates, body corp — it adds up fast." Smart buyers ask this question. And you deserve a straight answer. Here's what we provide before you sign anything: purchase price, stamp duty estimate, council rates, body corporate fees, legal costs, and any other applicable charges — all in one clear document. No guesswork. Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina for owner-occupiers. Near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. Get the full picture before you decide. Transparency is non-negotiable.
description: Every single cost itemised in one clear document before you sign anything
